description: Omaha, NE — This afternoon, in the third of three debates between the candidates running to represent Nebraska’s Second Congressional District, frontrunner Denise Powell proved yet again why momentum and enthusiasm are on her side as Brinker Harding continued to fail at articulating a clear vision for Nebraska.
